jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet Tech division specializes in designing and integrating cutting-edge software applications, including advanced portfolio management systems, sophisticated trading platforms and comprehensive banking and corporate solutions.

As a key contributor to the Group’s strategic advancements, the Pictet Tech division plays a vital role in driving transformative innovations that enhance our services and deliver exceptional value to our clients.

The Datacentre Infrastructure unit provides and maintains storage and virtualization platforms for on-premises applications across the Group, including file, object, archiving and backup services.

Your role

• Design, build, operate and continuously improve storage infrastructure platforms

• Keep infrastructure secure, up to date and online.

• Develop internal tooling and processes that improve efficiency and reduce operational risks.

• Promote infrastructure software development practices and DevOps.

• Teach, mentor, grow and advise other domain experts and teams in the organization.

• Participate in on-call duties in rotation with other team members.

Your profile

• Engineering or university degree.

• Significant knowledge of architecture topics such as integration, security and storage technologies (Kubernetes, Cinder, Commvault, Everpure).

• Experience with infrastructure management tools (monitoring and observability, logging, configuration management).

• Software craftsmanship practices, programming and scripting languages is a plus (Python, Java, Go, bash, PowerShell).

• Deeply curious, ready to help, always learning new skills and technologies.

• Team player with strong communication and interpersonal skills.

• Focuses on proactive strategies to prevent issues before they occur.

• Fluent in French and English.

• Must be resident in Switzerland.

What you might work on

• Optimizes critical workloads.

• Automate operations and implement monitoring systems on products.

• Contributes to defining the global storage offering at Pictet, including data tiering and supported protocols.

jobs.description:
Your role

Join our European headquarters of Bank Pictet & Cie (Europe) AG (BPAG) in Frankfurt am Main as we expand our dynamic European and German Project Team. We are seeking an experienced and motivated Senior Project Manager (m/f/d) to help drive our strategic and regulatory initiatives.

BPAG is a leading financial institution with a strong presence across Europe, operating branches in Luxembourg, Spain, Monaco, France, Italy and the UK. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to impactful projects within a collaborative, international environment at the heart of our Frankfurt office.

If you are passionate about project management and eager to make a difference in a prestigious, pan- e uropean organization, we look forward to your application.

Your team

• Design and implement strategies and new regulations that are not only aligned with the organization’s objectives but also leverage your in-depth banking expertise to ensure relevance and impact in a financial services context.

• Lead and manage multiple complex operational projects simultaneously , applying your strong banking knowledge to proactively identify challenges, question assumptions and drive projects toward successful, value-added outcomes.

• Engage and challenge subject matter experts (SMEs) and stakeholders at all levels including executives, management, team members and partners by bringing a critical, informed perspective that enhances project quality and effectiveness.

• Allocate and manage resources, budgets and personnel with a keen understanding of banking operations, ensuring that project execution is both efficient and compliant with industry standards and regulatory requirements.

• Identify, assess, and mitigate risks using your comprehensive knowledge of banking processes and regulations, ensuring project continuity and resilience in a dynamic environment.

• Monitor project performance and analyze key metrics , using your sector expertise to interpret results, anticipate issues and make informed adjustments that keep projects on track and aligned with business goals.

Your profile

• University degree (or equivalent higher education) in Business, Finance, or a related field; ideally complemented by an internationally recognized certification in Program and/or Project Management.

• Minimum of five years’ senior-level experience leading strategic, regulatory or change implementation projects within a top-tier financial institution or consulting firm.

• Deep understanding of end-to-end banking processes, from front- to back-office operations.

• Strong IT proficiency, with the ability to leverage technology in project delivery.

• Willingness and flexibility to travel as required.

• Fluency in English is essential; proficiency in German and French is an advantage.

• Excellent conflict management and resolution abilities, paired with outstanding organizational and multi-tasking skills.

• Exceptional communication, presentation and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage effectively with stakeholders at all levels.

Note

What we offer

At Pictet, you will find more than just a position—you will discover a unique opportunity to contribute to a distinguished private bank renowned for its tradition of independence, long-term thinking, partnership, responsibility and entrepreneurial spirit. We offer an attractive compensation package, comprehensive benefits and a strong commitment to your ongoing professional development. Continuous learning and personal growth are deeply valued and actively supported within our culture.

We invite you to join our engaged and collaborative team and to play a meaningful role in shaping the future of private banking at one of Europe’s most respected financial institutions. We look forward to welcoming you to Pictet.

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

• Profonda comprensione dei processi bancari end-to-end, dalle operazioni di front- to back-office.

BPAG ist ein führendes Finanzinstitut mit einer starken Präsenz in ganz Europa mit Niederlassungen in Luxemburg, Spanien, Monaco, Frankreich, Italien und Großbritannien. Dies ist eine aufregende Gelegenheit, zu wirkungsvollen Projekten in einem kollaborativen, internationalen Umfeld im Herzen unseres Frankfurter Büros beizutragen.

Wenn Sie sich für Projektmanagement begeistern und in einer renommierten, pan-europäischen Organisation etwas bewegen möchten, freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung.

Dein Team

• Konzipieren und implementieren Sie Strategien und neue Vorschriften, die nicht nur auf die Ziele des Unternehmens ausgerichtet sind, sondern auch Ihre fundierte Banking-Expertise nutzen, um Relevanz und Wirkung in einem Finanzdienstleistungskontext zu gewährleisten.

• Engagieren und fordern Sie Fachexperten (KMU) und Interessengruppen auf allen Ebenen heraus, einschließlich Führungskräfte, Management, Teammitglieder und Partner, indem Sie eine kritische, fundierte Perspektive einbringen, die die Qualität und Effektivität des Projekts verbessert.

Your team

Pictet Wealth Management (PWM) has an opening for a temporary internal communications specialist (maternity leave cover), reporting to the Head of Internal Communications and based in Geneva.

The team’s mission is to help foster an informed and engaged workforce dedicated to delivering an exceptional client experience, across PWM offices in Switzerland and abroad. This role will suit a highly organised, precise, creative and adaptable professional capable of conveying ideas with clarity and thriving in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

Your role

Manage the monthly business newsletter compilation, design and distribution

• Together with the Head of Internal Communications, manage the monthly editorial committee, send the invitations, reminders, and run the meetings;

• Actively participate with the Head of Internal Communications in the organisation of internal events, from planning, to invitations and logistics;

• Edit and post content on the PWM intranet homepage;

• Perform ad hoc access management;

• Manage analytics and prepare regular reports;

• Ensure clean formatting of email communications via the JungleMail template;

• Validate recipient lists before distribution.

Your team

Corporate Functions includes the Group’s non-banking activities and employs more than 600 people. These functions are carried out by specialists with expertise across all business units, and include the Communications, Compliance, Finance, Human Resources, Information Security, Internal Audit, Legal, Risk, Strategy & Projects, and Tax departments.

Reporting to the Learning & Talent Development Operations Manager, you will be working for the Pictet Academy, in the Human Resources department. The team supports the development of the Group’s employees and corporate culture at our offices around the world by assessing needs and implementing learning solutions to meet them.

Your role

You will provide operational and administrative support for training programmes and initiatives within the Pictet Academy and the Group’s Learning & Talent Development (LTD) community.
